messages:
sara: Heads-up: prod routing for /v1/generate is intermittently hitting very slow model instances. Saw some 5xx and 99th pct tails blowing past SLO. Starting a surgical toggle to route a portion of traffic to model-variant:fast-1. Please ack.

jay: Ack. Do we have a canary policy for emergency toggles? Prefer 10% -> 50% -> 100% if healthy.

sara: Yep. Plan is 10% now, monitor 2m, then 50%. I have rollback ready. Using console emergency override because control plane is fastest.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-453 - Routing anomaly (/v1/generate) - severity:high - oncall: @sara

sam: Quick note: if we inject header overrides we might lose x-customer-id in some old edge caches, which will cause telemetry gaps. Recommend adding a shim header to preserve tracking.

sara: Good call. Adding header shim in the override payload. Executing short command: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/overrides \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","match":"prefix","percent":10,"set_headers":{"X-Force-Route":"fast-1","X-Inject-Cust":"synthetic"}}'
```

nina: Monitoring dashboards: pre-flip we have 0.8% 5xx in 5m. After flip to 10% -> 0.2% for those shards. Latency p95 improved on fast-1 shards. Will keep eye on error budget and traces.

jay: Add a fallback policy in the override config: if fast-1 starts OOMing or error rate >2%, automatic fallback to cpu-fallback. How do we wire that to routing engine?

sara: Routing engine supports policy sets. I'm pushing a transient policy: canaryThreshold=2.0, fallbackRoute=legacy-cpu. If threshold breached, policy flips percent->0 automatically.

sara: Rollout steps (current):
1) 10% override applied at 1975555555
2) wait 120s, check error rate and traces
3) if error rate < 1% and traces look ok -> 50%
4) repeat check -> 100%
5) if any step fails -> run rollback command below

sam: Rollback payload: 
```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","percent":0}
```

deploy-bot: override-service deploy v2 complete (sha:abcd1234) - active

nina: Observability note: we're seeing a small telemetry gap where x-customer-id is missing for ~30s window from certain POPs. Reingesting logs for that range and enabling temporary alert so we can detect continued gaps.

sam: If fallback triggers, page oncall and toggle legacy route. Also add a quick rollback button in console runbook for this route.

sara: Agreed. I'll add a short UX note: emergency toggles should surface any injected headers and link to the rollback button. Filed a followup ticket in product. :thumbsup:

jay: +1. Also adding a link to the runbook and examples for header shims.

sara: Closing this thread after 30m unless we see regressions. Will capture a brief postmortem and update the playbook with the exact snippet we used. Thanks everyone.
